en.title: Surface Transportation Board: 8 references to U.S. Code sections repealed, omitted or not in the Code
en.summary: In the CFR chapters assigned to the Surface Transportation Board, 8 references in 8 sections cite a U.S. Code section that release point 119-134 of the U.S. Code does not carry in force: 7 cite a number the Code does not have; 1 cites a repealed section. The release names no successor for these sections.
en.impact: A reader who follows these references does not reach the text the rule relies on. No effect on a decision or an amount has been established.
en.correction: The agency decides whether to remove or replace each reference. The U.S. Code names no successor for these sections.
